name: Adrift Hunter's Flintlock
description: The favored weapon of a Shadow Hunter that bravely sailed to rid the night of terrors. The rage of the sea took every one of them - hunters, monsters, and all.

name: Astravian General Pistol
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal approach. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Aulorian Golden Gun
description: Let the golden reflections show you the way!

name: Aulorian Pistol
description: Let the golden reflections show you the way!

name: Blood Isle Corsair's Pistol
description: Stylized pistols meant to be shown off at midnight galas. That changed after its owner began ripping silver bullets out of their prey, passing curses to their weapons like the Queen's gift.

name: Blood Mage's Break-Top
description: Each shot uses a pint of blood, and the gun has a habit of shooting on its own without warning. Quenching its bloodthirst another reason to make all of your fights messy.

name: BountyHunter Commander's Flintlock (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: BountyHunter Commander's Flintlock (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Chaos Revolver
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: ChickenCowboy's Revolver
description: CLUCK CLUCK MOOOOOOVE'EM OUT! YEEEEHAW! Giddyup Heroes!

name: Chrono ShadowHunter Gun
description: What the bullet strikes, it leaves nothing behind. Bones disappear, blood is unmade, and a small hole in time begins to tear open.

name: Chrono ShadowSlayer Gun
description: What the bullet strikes, it leaves nothing behind. Bones disappear, blood is unmade, and a small hole in time begins to tear open.

name: Cold Delusions Sidearm
description: Each shot strikes true without mercy, the price being that your sight will fade. Each pull of the trigger brings your closer and closer to the clutches of the dark.

name: Colt Revolver
description: A repeating firearm that consists of multiple chambers and at least one barrel for firing.

name: Conquest's Regal Pistol
description: If you're going to challenge the Horseman of Conquest to a duel, I strongly recommend letting him keep the bow. Disarm him, and he'll pull out this baby. I did that during a spar, and couldn't stop laughing even when I got shot in the shoulder.

name: Cosmic Hunter's Blaster Pistol
description: Quick on the draw and surgical in precision, the target is dead before they hit the ground,. With a weapon this good, bringing in the bounty alive is going to cost extra. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Cowmander Pistol
description: What in tarnation, this isn't the wild west! These be the sweaty seas! Bring them cows home, boys!

name: Crypto Collector Gun
description: How do you collect that which does not exist… except in cyberspace?

name: Cursed Revolver
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds this gun.

name: Dark Astravian General Pistol
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Dark Naval Handgun (AC)
description: A firearm subtle in its connection to forbidden ritualistic magic. It always hits its target, at the cost of one day leading it's master to turn on a loved one.

name: Dark Naval Handgun (Non-AC)
description: A firearm subtle in its connection to forbidden ritualistic magic. It always hits its target, at the cost of one day leading it's master to turn on a loved one.

name: Dark Sea Corsair's Pistol
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Death's Culling Pistol
description: Guns like this are boring to the Horseman of Death. Like the operas he enjoys, the deaths he prefers are slow burns. A bullet ends things way too quickly and impersonally. If Lord Dage has Death in a hurry, this'll have to do.

name: Deathwalker Execution (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Execution (Non-AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Debris Commander's Gun (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye, cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim, Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Gun (Non-AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye, cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim, Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Pistol
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Dark Gun
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Light Gun
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: Diabolical Flintlock
description: An elaborate flintlock, perhaps more so for decoration than actual use, it's still good enough to blast a hole through your foes.

name: Die BlutSpucker
description: Each shot uses a pint of blood, and the gun has a habit of shooting on its own without warning. Try not to be wasteful.

name: Dire Delusions Sidearm
description: Each shot strikes true without mercy, the price being that your sight will fade. Each pull of the trigger brings your closer and closer to the clutches of the dark.

name: Dolphin Plushie
description: Dolphin Fact: They have the ability to let one half of their brain sleep, while the other half stays awake.

name: DragonSlayer Commander's Boomstick
description: Sea dragons are nothing like their counterparts in the skies. When facing these massive ocean terrors, Galanoth gears up in the heaviest weapons he can find before diving into the perilous depths.

name: DragonSlayer Commander's Pistol
description: Sea dragons are nothing like their counterparts in the skies. When facing these massive ocean terrors, Galanoth gears up in the heaviest weapons he can find before diving into the perilous depths.

name: DreadForce Handgun
description: Keep out of reach of irresponsible adults.

name: Ducky Isopod Plushie
description: It can quack and…make whatever noises ispods do.

name: Empire Fleet Flintlock
description: ﻿﻿The handle of this pistol writhes in your grasp. Sooner or later, it'll fuse with the skin of your palms.

name: Enchanted Balloon Gun
description: Designed for battling Air Elementals and other incorporeal beings. Be VERY careful this weapon doesn't POP in the middle of battle! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Corsair's Pistol
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it. (This item is color customizable to Accessory.)

name: Enchanted Volleyballer's WaterGun
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Energized TimeSplitter Gun
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Famine's Prodigal Pistol
description: Every bullet Famine fires from this pistol costs a mountain of gold…In a metaphorical way, right? If this empties the Horsemen's budget, we're going to make Famine and his steed get a job at Scarbucks.

name: Fiendish Outlaw Revolver
description: Any outlaw willing to serve and obey the orders of Nulgath the ArchFiend is welcome in the Nation. But beware… the price for betrayal is eternal suffering.

name: Fierce Laser Colt Pistol (AC)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Fierce Laser Colt Pistol (Non-AC)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Forsaken Outrider Blaster
description: Outriders that have left the Nation have turned the professions of bounty hunting and banditry. They left the Archfiend behind but their dirty work has seen little change.

name: FrostWarlord Handgun
description: Click this enchanted weapon's gem to activate its super-cool frosty attack form!

name: FrostWarlord Laser Gun
description: Click this enchanted weapon's gem to activate its super-cool frosty attack form!

name: GL-1ST Salvage Gun
description: It's made of salvaged parts, but they can still fire shots even after being submerged in mud.

name: GL-24K Gilded Gun
description: Every round is going to cost you a fortune of space-whatever currency. Do people still use NovaGems?

name: Gold Blood Isles Flintlock
description: A golden flintlock left behind by a noble seafarer were claimed by the Blood Isles. It gleams, as shiny as It was the day gold poured into the mold.

name: GrimSailor's Pistol
description: YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Big Iron
description: The shadows grow stronger each passing night. A wooden stake or a silver bullet won't do. Stab the beast's heart and shoot.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Bigger Iron
description: The kickback on this buddy bites harder than the beasts.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Biggest Iron
description: A shot through seven hearts. Can you beat that record?

name: Hadopelagic Grade Handgun (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Hadopelagic Grade Handgun (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Hitman's Pistol
description: Mission #357.A -- Chairman Platinum has ordered you to follow Target QV. Objective: observe, execute, report.

name: Hollowborn Admonition
description: Power and strength are the highest virtues of the Hollowborn Shadowslayers. Nothing less than the total eradication of all obstacles is acceptable.

name: Icy Flintlock
description: Shiver me timbers! It be th' Icy Naval Commander's flintlock! A pirate weapon this cool freezes over.

name: Infernal Hunter Rocket Launcher
description: The answer to most problems, especially Infernal problems, is more fire power.

name: Infernal Regina Flintlock (AC)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Infernal Regina Flintlock (Non-AC)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Ionized TimeSplitter Gun
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Jade Rabbit Flintlock
description: No matter where it's pointed, your shot will always hit your target. Just don't spend all your luck in one go.

name: League Competitor's Classic Gun (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Classic Gun (Non-AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Classic Gun (0 AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Classic Gun (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Gun (HandGun) (0 AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Gun (HandGun) (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Gun (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Gun (Legend)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: Light Thief Pistol (AC)
description: A pistol that relies solely on your mana. Even those that have little talent with Light magic can wield it. Some believe that Light magic should be exclusive to the chosen seek to destroy these kinds of weapons whenever possible.

name: Light Thief Pistol (Non-AC)
description: A pistol that relies solely on your mana. Even those that have little talent with Light magic can wield it. Some believe that Light magic should be exclusive to the chosen seek to destroy these kinds of weapons whenever possible.

name: Livyatan's Billow Harpoon
description: A precise shot in just the right spot can take down a monster five times the size of your ship. As your quarry slowly bleeds out, you follow the blood trail, like death lurking the waves.

name: Lorosian Hunter Handgun
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Lunar Thief Pistol (AC)
description: There's a charm on this pistol that puts the target to sleep rather than putting them to death. It could be a mercy, or it could be a cruelty to make them live with their failures.

name: Lunar Thief Pistol (Non-AC)
description: There's a charm on this pistol that puts the target to sleep rather than putting them to death. It could be a mercy, or it could be a cruelty to make them live with their failures.

name: Lunarian Blaster
description: This is one of the best weapons available for an Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon.

name: Malefic Curse Pistol (AC)
description: Take aim, fire, and take their soul before Death's hands can reach them. Their hate will be another bullet in your arsenal. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Malefic Curse Pistol (Non-AC)
description: Take aim, fire, and take their soul before Death's hands can reach them. Their hate will be another bullet in your arsenal. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Marauder's Pistol
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Merry Silver Pistol (0 AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Merry Silver Pistol (AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Midnight Sea Commander's Flintlock
description: There's no escape from the Midnight Sea, even if you make it back to land. The gold bullet lodged in your rib will turn you into a gilded statue - an enchanted treasure beacon for the ship to follow. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Mortal Doom Captain Pistol (0 AC)
description: A curse possesses this pistol, and it literally screams to see battle. Even the dead won't get any sleep.

name: Mortal Doom Captain Pistol (AC)
description: A curse possesses this pistol, and it literally screams to see battle. Even the dead won't get any sleep.

name: Mortis Chrono Gun
description: A Phantom Chronomancer seeks to maintain the natural order of time and space. Eliminating cowards living on borrowed time should be done with little disruption, but this gun is pretty loud…

name: Necro Crewmember's Flintlock
description: They shoot rounds that instantly rot their hapless targets into newly minted undead.

name: NeoBattleon Short Barrel Gun
description: For extra versatility, have a tech surgeon graft them to your bones.

name: Nightmare Hunter Pistol
description: Kill your fears with bullets, silver and iron. Just remember to point it at a nightmare, and deal with reality with your own hands.

name: Noblesse Mortelle Pistol (0 AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Noblesse Mortelle Pistol (AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Orca Plushie
description: The panda of the sea, but in appearance only. Personality wise, they're like the mean jocks of the sea. Life in the ocean isn't forgiving, but who cares! This is so soft!

name: Ornate Gold Pistol
description: Greed rules the wild west. Gold fillings from the teeth of the dead were taken from the dead, melted down, and used to decorate this cursed old pistol. It doomed the thief who made it, and it'll do the same with the thief who steals it.

name: Petrofire Flintlock
description: An extremely destructive gun, with a hint of fiery flair. There's a one in three chance that it'll blow up on you. What an insane rush!

name: Phantom Chrono Gun
description: A Phantom Chronomancer seeks to maintain the natural order of time and space. Eliminating cowards living on borrowed time should be done with little disruption, but this gun is pretty loud…

name: Phantom Naval Bladed Pistol (AC)
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds this gun.

name: Phantom Naval Bladed Pistol (Non-AC)
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds these guns.

name: Post-Apocalyptic Cowboy's Revolver
description: YEEEEEE-HAW! The post-apocalypse is wilder than the old West. The perfect for a desperado with a few morals and fast horse to find (or steal) success.

name: Pretty Pinkie Pirate Pistol
description: You'll need a holster to keep your pistol from floating away.

name: Prismastealth Viper Launcher
description: Sure, it blasts your enemies away. Sure, it's functional even when it's submerged in water. More importantly, the snake is named Nikita.

name: Pufferfish Plushie
description: If you poke them, they'll puff right up! Don't worry, those spines are soft and non-venomous.

name: Purgation Pistol
description: This pistol used to belong to an honest soul that tried to wipe away corruption. There is no trace of them that remains, leaving you to pick up from where they started.

name: Rot-Touched Pistol
description: Even a slight nick will kill you, just not right away. The wound starts looking gangrenous, and spreads until your entire body's zombified.

name: Royal Skye Pistol (0 AC)
description: Blessed by Iona's touch, this pistol is supercharged with her lightning. Multiple targets can be executed at once. To her quiet chagrin, the Queen's children were able to bless weapons like this as well.

name: Royal Skye Pistol (AC)
description: Blessed by Iona's touch, this pistol is supercharged with her lightning. Multiple targets can be executed at once. To her quiet chagrin, the Queen's children were able to bless weapons like this as well.

name: S.S. Doom Captain's Pistol (AC)
description: A curse possesses this pistol, and it literally screams to see battle. Even the dead won't get any sleep.

name: S.S. Doom Captain's Pistol (Non-AC)
description: A curse possesses this pistol, and it literally screams to see battle. Even the dead won't get any sleep.

name: S.S. Phantom Crossbow (0 AC)
description: The original crossbow that killed the S.S. Phantom's legendary captain. It's kept around as a cursed trophy, waiting to lodge an arrrow into the reincarnation of its original owner.

name: S.S. Phantom Crossbow (AC)
description: An old crossbow, the original that killed the S.S. Phantom's legendary captain. It's kept around as a cursed trophy, waiting to lodge an arrrow into the reincarnation of its original owner.

name: Scarred Infernal Flintlock (AC)
description: When Naal was still a Celestial, he had a fascination with weapons of all shapes and purposes. His brethren saw Azalith in him. Perhaps, this was what the Bright One had always intended.

name: Scarred Infernal Flintlock (Non-AC)
description: When Naal was still a Celestial, he had a fascination with weapons of all shapes and purposes. His brethren saw Azalith in him. Perhaps, this was what the Bright One had always intended.

name: Seahorse Plushie
description: A daring steed for a brave little guppie.

name: Seahorse Plushie XL
description: Daring steeds for brave little guppies!

name: Sealion Plushie
description: Thankfully, it's not nearly as loud as the real deal.

name: Seraphic Fourth Blaster
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Shadow Laser Colt Pistol (AC)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Shadow Laser Colt Pistol (Non-AC)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Shadow Oni's Pistol (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Shadow Oni's Pistol (Non-AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Shadowbound Pistol
description: The target of the pistol's bullets fall to their knees, melting into the shadows. Whole ship crews, villages, and even two sides of a naval battle can disappear just like that. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: ShadowFlame Commander's Pistol
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds! (CC to Trim)

name: ShadowFlame Eviscerator Pistol
description: The weapon gives a peek into the unforgiving cosmos. One day, the stars may become eyes that will scorn your power and prestiege

name: ShadowFlame Eviscerator Revolver
description: The weapon gives a peek into the unforgiving cosmos. One day, the stars may become eyes that will scorn your power and prestiege

name: ShadowLord Commander's Pistol
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds!

name: ShadowScale Blaster
description: Slithering through the shadowy back alleys of Akiba, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan live outside the law… but remain loyal to the Empress, a descendent of the Jade Serpent Prince.

name: Sidhe's Brigand Pistol
description: A pistol styled after the bewitching spectre haunting the brigand's dreams. It always hits the heart, and sports malicious wings.

name: Specter's Cursed Pistol
description: A curse laid by the previous owner grants terrible misfortune on those that dare steal from a pirate. Those that fall to it add their own curse. Just holding the pistols could invite the sea to swallow your ship.

name: Sturdy Viper Launcher
description: Sure, it blasts your enemies away. Sure, it's functional even when it's submerged in water. More importantly, the snake is named Nikita.

name: Sublimated ShadowSlayer's Pistol
description: Each of us faces a choice in life… do we embrace the Shadow, or choose to battle its creatures? Those who seek Light and life will always choose the latter.

name: Tactical Alpha Blaster
description: You'll never need to worry about running out of ammo. Extra rounds are always sprinkled all around town.

name: Timestream Ravager's Pistol
description: Those who can cross between times and worlds are the most dangerous of opponents. You never know where they will run to, or which direction they'll attack!

name: Tuba Cannon
description: ﻿Play forte, then fortissimo, then fortississimo, then fortississi - blast the horn so loud that you pass out-mo.

name: Underworld Magia Gun
description: The Underworld Magia are all undead but retain their preserved mortal forms. Their souls were torn from their bodies and forged into a matching weapon to channel their powerful magic.

name: Verdant Viper Launcher
description: They're called a venomous knives, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It only seems like the effects of venom.

name: VoidFiend Outlaw Revolver
description: If Nulgath the ArchFiend weren't such a viscious villain, you might just betray him… but you know what fate awaits the foolish rogues that cross him.

name: Volleyball Hero's WaterGun
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: War's Ironblood Pistol
description: The Horseman of War has the quickest trigger finger out of all of us riders. He shoots so fast that he doesn't realize his gun ran out of bullets until one of us walks right in front of him.

name: Werepyre Devotee's Silver Pistol
description: A prized silver pistol that was pried out of a ShadowSlayer's death-grip. They happen to hunt the same prey the Werepyres do, but the weapon was redesigned to better fit a dual nature.

name: Westion Commander's Flintlock (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Commander's Flintlock (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: XL Ducky Isopod Plushie
description: It can quack and…make whatever noises ispods do.

name: Zardian Pilot Minigun
description: A compact weapon that's easy to hide, and won't get jammed by copius amounts of sand. Perfect for covert ops in sandy environments, or sleeping underneath it. Zardians prefer that to tents.
